<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary conduct:</strong> Prime Minister Modi has urged new NDA MPs to maintain decorum and avoid disruptions in Parliament, emphasizing the institution&#x27;s fundamental importance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition pressure:</strong> Opposition leaders continue to demand the Home Minister&#x27;s presence in Parliament to address ongoing protests and accountability concerns, while Congress has issued a whip to its MPs regarding upcoming legislative debates.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative focus:</strong> While the government has finalized four bills for the session&#x27;s closing week, the FCRA Amendment Bill remains off the current agenda despite calls from the opposition for a review.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election oversight:</strong> The Election Commission of India and State Election Commissioners concluded a national round table conference in New Delhi to discuss electoral processes and institutional coordination.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOQ0JNQnhNVUx2Nk9vSnMycjdxbzhPV3o4azJmZUhTelNBd1JzQmlpWUhVRmd4Vm1TN2ctSXBKOGt4dEJrUlhZWWdtU2pFTHhCdVhjUTJvY09hVWotdWZ5WlEzck9ZRVFYb3VCMUNDS2xwT0txd2l5MmlqcmlIWFk5MXZlZnFPa0ZuWkQ2WkI2Q0poTy1NUkE1dmJPU1d5WDdYNDNZZFh1a0RMZi0zUTJYTDdFR0xwVDg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
